tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba 'dul ba las mngon shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

mngon shes bsgrub na: rang nyid thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i thugs khar: zla ba'i steng du yi ge drug pa dkar rum me bsam: mdun du ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang lo ka'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams gling bu glu dbyangs di ri ri sngags zlos par bsam zhing bsnyen par bya: khyad par du bud med g.yu'i zur phud can gyis phrag pa g.yas g.yon du tal tal smra bar bsam: yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su: phying dkar steng du nas bre gang la g.yung drung bris bya: shug pa rting dkar gsum gzug: dbus su bum pa gcig bca': nang du bzang drug: rgya gar ru rta: mar dkar gzhug: lha bshos: spos: 'o ma: mar khu: sbrang rtsi: spos dang tshil chen bsreg: mda' la me long dang pags bu: ratna btags la bum pa'i kha rgyan la gzug: bsnyen pa stong tsho re tshar ba dang: brdar la bod cing rnga chung brdung: nangs par khrus dang bsang bya: gser nag dang stag ras bcang: dam nyams dang mi 'grogs: mtshams drag tu bcad: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: la ti zad khram ci ta sham: de mā ra ya dza dza: ling nge khud: dud se sad: na mo tun dza dza: ti kra ma: tsa ta che che: kyor nyams la la khug dza dza: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snying po 'di bzlas pas: ye shes kyi lha ci byed zlo: rang mtho ris gar skye smra: lo ka'i lha ci byed smra: bdag gzhan tshe gang thub smra: sdig po che gar skye las bzang ngan smra: mang du bzlas na zhag bcu gnyis na thos:

bco lnga nas sems kyis rang shes: nyi shu la me long bzhin gsal: āoṃ a tre ku la chu bur mig gi sgo dbye: brgya rtsa brgyad dus gsum du bzlas la nangs par chu la btab ste khrus bya: gtor ma 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la mchod pa ci 'byor dbul: gsol ba gdab bo: rmi lam gsal po 'byung ngo: kye bdag la ting che ne: bu mo g.yu'i zur phud can: ma thogs myur du spyon: gser gyi wa thogs nas: nag mo mche ba can: ma thogs myur du spyon: tshil chen dud pas spyan 'dren na: nam mkha'i dbyings rum nas: ye shes lha mo gling bu ma: ma thogs myur du spyon: khyed kyi rten cig yod: nas nag bre gang yod: 'brang rgyas zhal dkar yod: dpal gyi bshos bu yod: shug gu rting dkar yod: 'dod pa rnam bzhi yod: ma thogs myur du spyon: ma mo nag mo dam la shog: skyabs khra mun 'gro dam la shog: bu mo g.yu'i zur phud dam la shog: lha dang mi yi sgrib pa sel: myur du rings par lhang lhang smros: ma thogs ta la 'dir smros: phye mar shing rtsis mchod: ma mo srid pa'i rgyud lung dang: ma mo srog gi thig le dang: ma mo srog gi se dar gyi rgyud nas: mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi snying po gcig tu dril ba: rang dbang med par 'gugs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi srung mar mnga' gsol ba: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis rje khri srong lde'u btsan la gnang:
a tsa ra dmar po la gser srang bdun phul nas zhus so: : bla ma mnga' bdag pas slob dpon khams pa la gnang ba lags so// rgya rgya rgya:
